title: launchyard (Incomplete)
tagline: Launchyard is Mobile DAO platform to learn, engage and find ppl to collaborate and build together
description:
We have built this platform keeping in mind that colleges should use and collaborate on this platform and enable DAO features that make them complete in various activities and vote to engage between students

We have used react native to build the mobile app and solidity contract for the DAO implementation and deployed it in the polygon.
